# Temple Scroll Column 21 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 21 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**21:1** And you shall make an altar of burnt offering, an altar of acacia wood, five cubits its length and five cubits its width, squared it shall be, and three cubits its height.

**21:2** And you shall make its horns upon its four corners; from it shall its horns be, and you shall overlay it with copper.

**21:3** And you shall make its pots for removing its ashes, and its shovels and its basins and its flesh-hooks and its fire-pans; all its vessels you shall make of copper.

**21:4** And you shall make for it a grating, a work of copper network, and you shall make upon the network four rings of copper upon its four corners.

**21:5** And you shall set it beneath the ledge of the altar, below, and the network shall reach to the middle of the altar.

**21:6** And you shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and you shall overlay them with copper.

**21:7** And the poles shall be inserted into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.

**21:8** Hollow with planks you shall make it; as I showed you on the mountain, thus shall they make it.

**21:9** And you shall overlay it with pure copper, its top and its sides all around and its horns; and you shall make for it a border of gold all around.

**21:10** And the altar shall be most holy to Me; every thing that touches the altar shall become holy.

**21:11** And you shall make a ramp to the altar on its south side; you shall not go up by steps upon My altar that your nakedness be not uncovered upon it.

**21:12** And the ramp — its length shall be sixteen cubits, and its width ten cubits, ascending from the south.

**21:13** And you shall set the altar before the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and you shall place the ramp to the south.

**21:14** And between the altar and the house you shall set a distance of twenty cubits all around.

**21:15** And no stranger who is not of the seed of Aaron shall approach to offer incense of spice before Me upon the altar.

**21:16** And no one shall come near it who has not been consecrated and clothed with the holy garments; holy it shall be, most holy.

---

*EMET notes: Column 21 is well preserved. The altar description draws on Exodus 27:1-8 and 30:1-10 but reformulated in God's first-person voice, characteristic of the Temple Scroll. Measurements preserved literally in cubits. "Squared" (rabu'a) rendered as literal adjective.*
